article.title: Appeal from order rejecting application for restoration of attached property
article.content: Any person referred to in sub-section (3) of section 88, who is aggrieved by any refusal to deliver property or the proceeds of the sale thereof may appeal to the Court to which appeals ordinarily lie from the sentences of the first-mentioned Court.
article.html:
89Appeal from order rejecting application for restoration of attached property

Section 89 · Chapter VI · Proclamation and attachment

Any person referred to in sub-section (3) of section 88, who is aggrieved by any refusal to deliver property or the proceeds of the sale thereof may appeal to the Court to which appeals ordinarily lie from the sentences of the first-mentioned Court.
